out_of_scope_observations.observation: saveMutations success handler (lines 2462-2467) updates save status and budget but does NOT update editorTripData or call setEditorTripData. This is the upstream cause of the AC8 blocker: even after fix_pass_4 reads editorDay.stage correctly, a successful Approve mutation does not mutate editorTripData.days[n].stage, so editorDay (derived from editorTripData via useMemo) remains at the pre-approve stage value on the same page session.

applySelection() inside CandidatesSidebar (line 2071) contains correct setEditorTripData cross-meal copy logic but is NEVER called anywhere. No call site exists in the file. Candidate drops go through slot-drop handlers -> window.setEditorSelection bridge, never through applySelection. This function is dead code. It should either be wired into the bridge or deleted.

applyBridge (tap-to-select, line 2495) also does NOT copy option objects to editorTripData — only sets editorSelections for the target slot. Same root cause as window.setEditorSelection bridge for AC20.

route_cache.schema.json mode field enum lists ['walk','taxi','metro','bus','transit','car','ferry'] but frontend sends mode: 'driving'. Schema non-conformance only; no runtime crash. Carried forward from fix_pass_3 QA.
fetchRoute .catch() handler at line 2418 sets {status:'error'} without the stale-sequence guard. Race condition edge case. Carried forward from fix_pass_3 QA.

FIX C accommodation stamping (lines 1915-1922) is dead code: condition is Array.isArray(day.accommodation) but PLAN_DATA accommodation is always an object, never an array. Does NOT affect AC17 because KanbanView placed accommodation cards (line 1249) have no onDragStart. Carried forward from fix_pass_3 QA.
